response.overview: After leaving Myanmar amid political upheaval, Ko Thu arrives in Thailand in search of a temporary refuge. Parting ways with his traveling companion, he finds shelter in a small room offered by his friend Ko Wi. As he adjusts to unfamiliar surroundings, unexpected experiences begin to unsettle his daily life. Within the room’s confined walls, a place of refuge becomes a source of uncertainty. What awaits him inside the room?
response.title: The Room
